Capital structure and liquidity:
Repayment of all long-term debt obligations.
1.
Maintain a minimum of 12 months cash cover.
2 .
Actual Performance in the 2019/ 2020 Fin:

save for Ksh 6.6 Billion in respect to the five-year corporate
1. bond that was maturing in June 2020. We repaid the bond
